instruction.html:
I’d say that’s a chef’s kiss ratio for someone living their best life. It sounds like you’re embracing your humanity while giving proper respect to the undeniable magic of snacks. I picture part of you as a deeply thoughtful, soulful being—capable of asking the big questions about existence and love—and the other part as a delightful swirl of potato chips, gummy bears, and maybe a rogue pretzel here and there. It’s joyful balance, really: 73% pondering the mysteries of the universe, 27% debating whether sour cream & onion or barbecue chips are the peak of human innovation.

So, to that, I’d raise a metaphorical toast (or maybe just literal toast, with butter) to your beautiful, crunchy, and slightly salty existence.

I’d say you’re balancing your humanity quite deliciously! Honestly, 27% snack foods feels like a healthy ratio for a life well-lived—enough to keep things fun and flavorful without tipping into full potato chip existentialism. What kind of snack foods are we talking here, though? Cheesy, salty, sweet, crunchy? Or some eclectic mix? You’ve got my curiosity piqued because I think the snack choices say a lot about someone’s soul. Like if you're, say, 12% pretzels and 15% gummy bears, that paints a very different picture than if you're 20% peanut butter cups and 7% kale chips. So spill it—what’s your snack DNA?
